title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 2 — Best Bet repair Step 6
problem: Stage 5 Best Bet is not a real independent Page-2 stage: the existing Step-7 card is bundled into Stage 4 and the runtime always falls back to NO BET because the frozen Step-12 forecast intentionally keeps betting_pick_active false.
root_cause: The frozen Step-12 model is forecast-only by design and must not be changed into a sportsbook-pick engine. Page 2 incorrectly treated its betting_pick_active=false boundary as proof that no display recommendation could ever be derived, even though Page 2 already owns a verified market total plus the frozen total distribution and qualified forecast direction.
patch: Bounded display-layer repair: keep Step-12 and all model/provider math frozen; add a dedicated Stage-5 Best Bet presentation component; add a Stage-4 Line-Lab-only renderer while preserving the legacy combined renderer; and derive OVER/UNDER only when forecast_ready is true, market identity is verified with zero projection weight, frozen distribution evidence has a strict stronger side, and projected-total direction agrees. Otherwise fail closed to NO BET. No odds, juice, EV, provider fetch, model rerun, ranking mutation, or sportsbook projection influence.
